name: What types of flooring offer the best return on investment for home sellers?

mainEntity.name: What types of flooring offer the best return on investment for home sellers?

acceptedAnswer.text: For home sellers, durable and widely appealing options tend to offer the best return. Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) is a popular choice due to its affordability, resilience, and realistic wood or stone appearance. Engineered hardwood provides a classic look and warmth, often preferred by buyers. Neutral-toned, high-quality carpet can work well in bedrooms for comfort. Focus on materials that are easy to maintain, resistant to wear, and have broad buyer appeal rather than highly specific or custom options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) and engineered hardwood offer strong returns for sellers due to their appeal and durability. Neutral, high-quality carpet is good for bedrooms.
